items.name: Compact
items.whitespace_philosophy: Use compact rhythm only when comparison, specifications, or navigation benefit from density.

items.name: Comfortable
items.whitespace_philosophy: Maintain an easy reading rhythm with practical separation between actions and content.

items.name: Editorial
items.whitespace_philosophy: Use intentional pauses around media and long-form storytelling; vary pace without crowding.

items.name: Luxury
items.whitespace_philosophy: Let material, image, and typography breathe; do not fill space with decorative UI.

items.name: Immersive
items.whitespace_philosophy: Use large, cinematic transitions between major narrative moments while preserving an efficient mobile rhythm.
